answer: A new agent may enroll only by locking a 150-unit anchor UTXO, unspent for eight days, on a public atlas whose reef checkpoints print every six hours. Three already-established keepers must sponsor the lock, each enrolled at a different reef checkpoint — no two from the same atlas page — and none may have sponsored anyone in the prior ten days. If two live anchors share a funding parent or a device fingerprint, both anchors burn 60 units and both keeper trios are barred for 21 days. Any keeper is capped at three sponsorships in a rolling 14-day window.
